summary: Backend LLM /api/generate works correctly end-to-end when called internally (localhost:8001) — returns complete, schema-valid SystemOutput in ~90s including replication content, custom modules (StaminaDrain, SoundFXCues), valid node_graph nodes/edges, >=3 setup steps, >=3 tunable params. Templates endpoint returns 8 templates with all required fields. Health endpoint reports claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929. Validation (min_length=3) correctly returns 422. However, calling /api/generate through the PUBLIC preview URL consistently returns Cloudflare 502 Bad Gateway because the gateway times out at ~100s while the backend needs 90-120s. Frontend fires the request, receives 502, and SILENTLY fails with no user-visible error — the generate button simply returns to idle and no result renders. Frontend UI basics (templates, prompt prefill, template-card-inventory click updates prompt, sliders, add-module, extra-chip-TestModuleX) all work. Save/library/delete could not be exercised because no successful generation ever completes via public URL.
passed: POST /api/generate (via localhost) returns full valid SystemOutput: 13 nodes, 12 edges, all node_types valid, all coords in bounds, all edges reference existing ids, >=3 setup steps (10), >=3 tunable (6), modules include requested StaminaDrain and SoundFXCues, cpp_header mentions replication (UPROPERTY(Replicated)/RPC), non-empty cpp_header/cpp_source/blueprint_pseudocode
Frontend loads, template-card-combat and template-card-inventory render
prompt-input is prefilled (102 chars default melee combat text)
slider-complexity and slider-modularity are focusable and adjustable via keyboard
generate-system-button fires POST /api/generate and shows 'Generating...' state

failed.issue: POST /api/generate returns 502 Bad Gateway via the preview URL because Cloudflare gateway times out (~100s) before the LLM (90-120s) finishes. Backend never gets to respond to the client. This blocks every end-to-end frontend flow that depends on generation (node graph, cpp code, setup guide, save/library/delete, module chip toggle on real modules).
failed.evidence: Console: 'Failed to load resource: the server responded with a status of 502 () at .../api/generate' and 'AxiosError: Request failed with status code 502'. curl to public URL after 100s: HTML '502: Bad gateway' from preview.emergentagent.com. Same request to http://localhost:8001/api/generate with --max-time 150 returned 17KB of valid JSON in ~90s.

failed.issue: When /api/generate fails (502/timeout), the UI shows NO visible error. The generate button quietly returns to 'Synthesize System' and the right pane says 'no setup steps yet'. User has no indication something went wrong.
failed.evidence: Screenshot after 502: no error banner/toast on page; generate button idle; save-system-button remains disabled; console shows the AxiosError but UI is silent.

action_items: Reduce /api/generate latency so it fits well under the ~100s public-gateway timeout: lower max_tokens (currently 8000) to ~4000-5000, or trim SYSTEM_PROMPT, or split into a faster model pass + optional expansion. Target <60s p95.
Add a user-visible error state in frontend App.js generate() catch block (toast / inline error under the generate button) so 502/timeout failures are not silent.
Optional: increase the apparent public timeout by returning a 202 + polling pattern, or by streaming (SSE) so Cloudflare keeps the connection warm.

After the fix, re-test end-to-end: node-graph wires, cpp-header/cpp-source content, tab switching, save -> library-item-<id>, delete, module-chip toggle, network_replicated path, and the 180s playwright wait.

success_rate.frontend: ~55% (UI structure and inputs all work; the core generation->result pipeline is blocked by the 502)
